skygo --help
stdout 'targets'
stdout 'jobs'
stdout 'server'
! stdout '\x1b'
! skygo not-a-command
stderr 'unknown command'

# Generated Connect client against a real HTTP handler. No ANSI in pipe output.
skygo targets list
stdout 'NAME +KIND'
stdout 'local +local'
! stdout '\x1b'
skygo --json targets list
stdout '"targets":'
stdout '"name": *"local"'
! stderr .

! skygo --token wrong targets list
stderr 'unauthenticated'
! skygo jobs get missing
stderr 'not_found'
! skygo jobs cancel j1
stderr 'requires --yes'
skygo jobs logs j1
stdout '^hello\n$'

! skygo plan -f invalid.yaml
stderr 'field unsupported not found'
! skygo run -f task.yaml --wait --request-id retry-me
stdout 'j1.*failed'
stderr 'request-id: retry-me'

-- invalid.yaml --
argv: [echo, hello]
unsupported: true
-- task.yaml --
argv: [false]
